name: GUI Shop by Rickiewars
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: rickiewars
description: GuiShop is a Fabric server-side mod to create and manage GUI shops in Minecraft. It comes with its own economy but also integrates seamlessly with other economy providers. GuiShop is based on the works of UnsafeDodo, adapted and extended to fit my needs.
needs: Mixin: 80 points inside the game's methods
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.

softOff.why: @redirect and @wrap-method and @wrap-operation into the game's classes; registers blocks, items or entities (they stay, inert)
